title: View-only: every editing affordance is hidden or disabled
permissions_required: A role with Schedule: View but NOT Edit.
preconditions: 1. A test user's role has Schedule: View but NOT Edit.
2. Shifts, a series, and events exist on the grid.
3. You are signed in AS that View-only user on a desktop browser, on the Schedule page.
steps: 1. Look for drag handles on sidebar lines and try to drag a work order card onto the grid.
2. Try dragging an existing shift block (move/reassign) and look for resize handles in day view.
4. Open a shift's detail modal and inspect its fields and actions.
expected: 1. No drag handles are offered and nothing can be dragged from the sidebar onto the grid.
2. Shift blocks cannot be moved or resized - no drop targets or resize handles appear.
3. The right-click context menu does not appear (no New Shift / New Event / View Day creation entry points).
4. In the modal, edit fields are hidden or disabled, and the reassign and delete actions are absent.
design_ref: Claude design (authoritative, Branko Q0): build/schedule/spec-v1-2026-07-22/design-notes-claude.md (prototype Schedule.dc.html). spec_1 added the Design link to the doc.
spec_ref: requirements.md §14.1 (Schedule: View - editing affordances hidden or disabled)

notes: Spec allows 'hidden or disabled' - record which of the two the build does for each affordance.
